svg.title: Grid-Up Datathon
svg.desc: Grid-Up Datathon — Kaggle · 493 teams · team TasnifX. Daily electricity-use forecasts for 7,036 distribution transformers, with separate models for units with and without past data. 7,036 transformers (forecast daily); 1.5k tests; 80 decision records. Stack: Python, CatBoost, LightGBM, XGBoost.
